ideas.title: The Scale and Impact of Fraud in Minnesota's Daycare Sector
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of fraud in Minnesota's daycare sector, focusing on the USDA's Child and Adult Care Food Program.
questions: How widespread is fraud in Minnesota's daycare sector?
What measures are being taken to prevent future fraud?
searches: USDA Child and Adult Care Food Program
ideas.insight: The recent cases of fraud in Minnesota's daycare sector suggest a need for greater oversight and control measures to protect public funds.

ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future Fraud: A Deeper Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged $9B fraud by Feeding Our Future, a nonprofit accused of misusing federal funds meant for child nutrition programs.
questions: What were the mechanisms used by Feeding Our Future to carry out the alleged fraud?
How did the nonprofit avoid detection for so long?
ideas.insight: The scale and complexity of the alleged fraud by Feeding Our Future suggest a sophisticated scheme that exploited weaknesses in oversight and control measures.
